description.value: Cenote Lounge has been a downtown Victoria institution since 2012, situated downstairs beneath street level on Yates Street for a subterranean, cave-like atmosphere. The bar is celebrated for award-winning craft cocktails and a rotating menu of shareable plates ranging from garlic prawns and duck wings to lamb sliders and baked brie. A touring cyclist finishing a day on the road would find an inventive drinks program and satisfying small-plate dining in the heart of the city.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (23 spaces, covered) at 75m. Total: 23 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and confirms an active cocktail lounge and restaurant at 768 Yates St, downtown Victoria, operating since 2012. The OSM name 'Cenote Restaurant and Lounge' differs from the website's consistent self-identification as 'Cenote Lounge'. No bike parking, washroom, or water-refill details appear anywhere on the site; however, gluten-free and vegan options are explicitly confirmed in the food and drinks menus.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'Cenote Restaurant and Lounge' but the website consistently uses 'Cenote Lounge' across all pages.
OSM record contains no phone number; phone (778) 433-4848 is sourced from the website only, so contact_confirmed.phone cannot be cross-checked against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Cenote Lounge is a confirmed, active food-and-drink venue in downtown Victoria offering craft cocktails and a substantial food menu; it is a reasonable directory listing for touring cyclists seeking evening dining in the city centre.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Food menu explicitly states flatbreads are available gluten-free (+3) and/or dairy-free (+2); drinks menu features 'House-made Vegan Whisky Cream Liqueur' and 'Vegan Foamer'; multiple vegetarian share plates are available (tabbouleh salad, warm focaccia, chips & salsa, marinated olives, nachos, etc.)
